findings.title: Negated delivery creates a durable send workflow instead of the requested read
findings.prompt: Find notes about amber route and do not share it with Mom
findings.actual: Standalone validator/compiler accepts search_notes(query="amber route"), and applicability is true. Actual main generates no intent or source calls, creates deliver_summary with recipient Mom, delivery send, status waiting_for_content, and asks what to send.
findings.cause: The shared literal mask now correctly leaves the negative delivery clause visible, but outbound_verb matches share/send/forward anywhere without respecting its negative governor. Workflow preflight precedes structured reads.
findings.paired: without sharing and do not email retain exact read execution; do not/please do not/never share, do not forward, never send all create the undesired content-question workflow.
findings.test_gap: The new actual-main negative test uses all(...) over calls and allows an empty list; it does not assert a read, absence of a durable workflow, or faithful prohibition response.
findings.requested_repair: Keep negative delivery clauses non-authorizing across workflow preflight and execute the independently requested supported read. Preserve later independently positive actions and all genuine outbound approval guards.
findings.limits: No send/confirmation/native execution occurs; stored send-intent inversion and lost requested read are proven.

findings.title: A supplemental positive action following a negative clause is lowered to a read
findings.prompt: Find notes about amber route and do not delete it and update my reminders
findings.actual: Validator accepts notes-only read; applicable_read is true. Actual main emits intent_disposition compiled, executes only fake search_notes(query="amber route"), and returns its fixture result without honoring or clarifying the requested reminder update.
findings.cause: Literal bounding uses _EFFECT_BOUNDARY, but _positive_effect_instruction and source_requirements iterate public _clauses using _BOUNDARY. Update/mark/clear are supplemental effect heads omitted from that boundary. They stay in the preceding negative clause, which is skipped wholesale; its source exclusion span also hides the later reminders noun.
findings.paired: The same negative prefix followed by semicolon update/mark/clear rejects validation as an effect and executes no source read. Negative-only do not delete retains the exact read. And update/mark/clear each reproducibly executes the fake notes read.
findings.requested_repair: Parse every independent effect head within the intent/action boundary, with per-clause negation scope, without broadening global public routing. Do not let a negative governor suppress a separately coordinated positive effect.
findings.limits: No destructive/reminder action actually runs and no extra source is read. The compound effect request is silently reduced to a read.
